body:
The bottle looked clean until it dried, when a green line appeared above the water. We had filled it from the tap after the field truck sprayed the far rows, the ones with the new seed mix.

The dog would not drink from the dish left outside. I kept the bottle until someone could tell me what was in that spray.
title: Diary page

body:
The new pesticide rig came through early morning. Even my covered herbs were wilting by evening.

Yellow residue coated the car and laundry on the line. I pressed this leaf to see if the next row would go the same way.
title: Garden notes

body:
The treated seed arrived with double concentration markings. Driver said it was meant for commercial spray equipment. We stored the sacks near the rain barrel overnight.

Chemical residue washed into our water during the storm. Everything watered from the barrel yellowed within days. The dilution ratio printed was for industrial use only.
title: Treatment Record

body:
The workers marked the trial acres with stakes that morning. By afternoon the pale dust had settled on our garden rows. I watched them spray only the test section but both fields wilted.

The boundary stakes did not contain it.
title: Field notes

body:
I was asked to keep this sample apart from the cooking jars. Its lid came loose on the way back from the orchard. The grocery bag was set on the table before I noticed the sweet chemical smell.

The child's blanket was drying nearby and held the same fine dust. The potted peppers on the sill curled the next morning. I had meant to save it only until someone could explain the difference.
title: Diary page

body:
They taped off the boundary posts after the checkpoint went up. The path we knew to the outer road now lies beyond the last post. We had walked it that morning with the children, before a patrol turned us back and noted down our names.

We were told not to use the path again and to say nothing if questioned. I folded this page small and put it away from the others.
title: Notebook page

body:
The calves refused their water before the county car appeared. I poured it into a spare pail and found an oily rim when it settled. We had drawn it from the same shallow well as ours.

The dog would no longer drink from the dish left outside. I left the date on the page and did not try to straighten the damaged edge. Someone else might remember the same afternoon.
title: Letter

body:
The driver washed the sprayer beside the feed shop. He paid for soap but not for another bucket. The rinse water ran through the drain toward gardens downhill, and the beds there showed bleached leaf edges by the weekend.

I kept the paper separate from the bills because the person involved might come back for it.
title: Notepad page

body:
The first rain after the field treatment left yellow flecks in a pan under the leak. We had shut the window before the truck came. I saved the pan because no one believed me when I described it.

The next family along the road noticed the smell without seeing the truck. I had meant to save it only until someone could explain the difference. By then the ordinary work around us had stopped.
title: Diary page

body: The receipt includes a charge for trial pesticide in sample jars. A household address is written beside it, not a field number. The concentration marked is higher than on the field containers. Reapplication was scheduled three days after the first delivery.
title: Order receipt
